summary_1line: Bhima gathers Saugandhika lotuses after slaying Yaksha guards; ominous signs alarm Yudhishthira, who finds him and warns against rashly offending the gods.

image_candidates.scene_text: Bhima stands on the lotus lake’s shore with mace raised, surrounded by smashed Yaksha bodies and crimson lotuses.
Dark winds, meteors, and red skies sweep the forest as Yudhishthira senses looming battle.
The Pandavas arrive at the fragrant lotus lake and see Bhima alone, biting his lip and glaring across the water.
